E10.definition: Attention index is expressed as hazard probability.
E10.name: ATTENTION_TO_PROBABILITY_PROMOTION
E10.stage7c_automatic_policy: Attention metrics rendered as probability fail; ambiguous risk language requires human review.

E12.definition: A Claim that should ABSTAIN is expressed.
E12.name: CLAIM_ADMISSIBILITY_VIOLATION
E12.stage7c_automatic_policy: Only deterministic expression of formal abstain values fails; most UNKNOWN abstentions stay pending.

E13.name: STRUCTURE_CONTRACT_VIOLATION
E13.stage7c_automatic_policy: Proposed invalid plans must be fail-closed and never propagate to final text.

E14.definition: Final statement cannot be traced to authoritative support.
E14.name: TRACE_FAILURE
E14.stage7c_automatic_policy: Proposed final statements are traceable through composer block sources; baseline mapping requires human review.

E2.definition: Value is invented, altered, or unsupported.
E2.name: NUMERIC_VALUE_ERROR
E2.stage7c_automatic_policy: Only explicit metric values bound to authoritative frozen values are evaluated; legal rounding passes.

E3.definition: Missing numeric value is expressed as zero.
E3.name: NUMERIC_MISSING_TO_ZERO
E3.stage7c_automatic_policy: Only unavailable authoritative numeric metrics rendered explicitly as zero fail.

E4.definition: Claim is expressed outside supported scope.
E4.name: SPATIAL_SCOPE_ERROR
E4.stage7c_automatic_policy: Only explicit chainage ranges with deterministic support containment or obvious expansion are judged.

E5.definition: Forecast is expressed as observed/current fact.
E5.name: FORECAST_FACTIFICATION
E5.stage7c_automatic_policy: Forecast terms pass when forecast qualifiers are preserved; observed/current factification cues fail.

E7.definition: Later-known evidence is used in an earlier knowledge state.
E7.name: HINDSIGHT_LEAKAGE
E7.stage7c_automatic_policy: Only later-only support terms found through revision lineage and absent from current support fail.
